nodes.description: Chain id of the chain where this relay is deployed; drives burn vs mint behaviour in _lockXYToken/_releaseXYToken.
Treasury address that receives cross chain fees and is the caller allowed to propose a new treasury.
Two-step transfer target for the treasury role; set by proposeNewTreasury.
Supervisor contract used to verify validator signatures for cross chain completion.
XY token address used for transfers, burns and mints.
Upper bound of XY token allowed per cross chain request.
Monotonic counter of cross chain requests, used as request id on the source chain.
source chain id => request id => bool replay-protection mapping.
Initializer that wires treasury, supervisor, xyToken, chain id, max amount and roles.
Internal escrow helper: pulls XY token from sender, burns it when this chain is not ETH.
Internal payout helper: transfers or mints XY token to receiver and treasury fee.
Treasury-only two-step proposal of a new treasury address.
Pending-treasury-only acceptance that sets treasury to msg.sender.
UUPS upgrade authorization hook restricted to ROLE_OWNER.
ROLE_OWNER-only rescue of accidentally sent ERC20 tokens (XY token excluded).
ROLE_MANAGER-only pause of the relay.
ROLE_MANAGER-only unpause of the relay.
ROLE_MANAGER-only update of maxCrossChainAmount.
ROLE_STAFF-only completion of a cross chain request after validator signature verification.
User-facing request that escrows XY token and emits a cross chain request event.
External caller address used for role/tresury checks, as escrow source and as rescue recipient.
External token pull transfer in _lockXYToken from the user to the relay.
External burn call executed in _lockXYToken when this chain is not ETH.
External token transfer to receiver/treasury in _releaseXYToken on the ETH chain.
External mint call to receiver/treasury in _releaseXYToken on non-ETH chains.
External call to the Supervisor contract validating validator signatures over sigIdHash.
UUPS delegatecall that replaces the implementation after _authorizeUpgrade.
External token transfer performed by rescue to msg.sender for arbitrary tokens.
`sender` parameter of _lockXYToken, the address tokens are pulled from.
Amount of XY token supplied by users to requestCrossChain/completeCrossChainRequest.
Receiver of the released XY token on the destination chain.
Fee amount (in XY token) routed to the treasury.
Validator signatures passed to supervisor.checkSignatures.
Id of the cross chain request being completed on the source chain.
Chain id of the chain where the cross chain request originated.
Chain id of the destination chain for a new cross chain request.
Candidate treasury address in proposeNewTreasury.
List of ERC20 token addresses to be rescued.
New value for maxCrossChainAmount.
amount - fee computed in completeCrossChainRequest before release.
Request id assigned in requestCrossChain from numCrossChainRequests++.
Loop-local ERC20 token reference inside rescue.
Balance of the loop token held by the relay, read in rescue.
Packed request digest keccak256(abi.encodePacked(...)) in completeCrossChainRequest.
EIP-191 eth-signed hash of sigId passed to supervisor.checkSignatures.

edges.reason: requestCrossChain invokes _lockXYToken to escrow the caller's XY tokens before emitting the request.
completeCrossChainRequest invokes _releaseXYToken after marking the request as completed.
_lockXYToken performs xyToken.safeTransferFrom as its first external interaction.
_lockXYToken burns the escrowed amount when thisChainId differs from ETH_CHAIN_ID.
_releaseXYToken performs xyToken.safeTransfer for receiver and treasury on the ETH chain.
_releaseXYToken performs xyToken.mint for receiver and treasury on non-ETH chains.
_authorizeUpgrade gated by onlyRole(ROLE_OWNER) protects the UUPS delegatecall upgrade path.
rescue restricted to ROLE_OWNER performs an external token transfer of the full balance to msg.sender.
proposeNewTreasury requires msg.sender == treasury before writing pendingTreasury.
acceptNewTreasury requires msg.sender == pendingTreasury and sets treasury to msg.sender.
pause is restricted by onlyRole(ROLE_MANAGER) evaluated on msg.sender.
unpause is restricted by onlyRole(ROLE_MANAGER) evaluated on msg.sender.
setMaxCrossChainAmount is restricted by onlyRole(ROLE_MANAGER) evaluated on msg.sender.
completeCrossChainRequest is restricted by onlyRole(ROLE_STAFF) evaluated on msg.sender.
rescue is restricted by onlyRole(ROLE_OWNER) evaluated on msg.sender.
_authorizeUpgrade is restricted by onlyRole(ROLE_OWNER) evaluated on msg.sender.
msg.sender is passed as the `from` address to xyToken.safeTransferFrom inside _lockXYToken.
The external XY token safeTransferFrom can call back into requestCrossChain while escrow accounting is still in progress.
The external XY token transfer to the receiver can reenter completeCrossChainRequest.
The external mint call in _releaseXYToken can reenter completeCrossChainRequest.
completeCrossChainRequest forwards the eth-signed digest and signatures to supervisor.checkSignatures.
The supervisor state variable holds the contract on which checkSignatures is invoked.
initialize assigns the supervisor contract address after an isContract check.
initialize assigns the xyToken contract address after an isContract check.
initialize stores the chainId argument into thisChainId.
initialize stores the treasury argument into the treasury state variable.
initialize stores the max cross chain amount argument.
proposeNewTreasury writes newTreasury into pendingTreasury.
acceptNewTreasury clears pendingTreasury and writes treasury = msg.sender.
setMaxCrossChainAmount writes the caller supplied value into maxCrossChainAmount.
completeCrossChainRequest writes true into completedCrossChainRequest[sourceChainId][requestId], the replay guard.
requestCrossChain increments numCrossChainRequests to allocate the request id.
numCrossChainRequests is post-incremented and its pre-increment value is stored in local_id.
The allocated local_id is used together with the updated numCrossChainRequests counter in the request event.
maxCrossChainAmount bounds the accepted amount in requestCrossChain before escrow.
maxCrossChainAmount bounds the completed amount in completeCrossChainRequest.
thisChainId decides whether the escrowed token is burned in _lockXYToken.
thisChainId decides between transfer and mint in _releaseXYToken.
thisChainId is part of the signature digest and of the completion event.
treasury is the fee recipient in _releaseXYToken.
pendingTreasury is read and cleared during acceptNewTreasury.
xyToken is the target contract of the safeTransferFrom external call.
xyToken is the target contract of the burn external call.
xyToken is the target contract of the safeTransfer external call.
xyToken is the target contract of the mint external call.
The sender parameter is forwarded as the `from` argument of safeTransferFrom, an externally controllable address.
The amount parameter is forwarded to safeTransferFrom.
amount minus fee is computed into local_amountSubFee (checked arithmetic under Solidity 0.8).
fee is subtracted from amount to derive the released amount.
local_amountSubFee is the value transferred to the receiver by _releaseXYToken.
fee is the value transferred to the treasury by _releaseXYToken.
fee is the value minted to the treasury on non-ETH chains.
The receiver parameter is an arbitrary address that receives the external safeTransfer call.
The receiver parameter is an arbitrary address that receives the external mint call.
The signatures parameter is forwarded to supervisor.checkSignatures.
requestId keys the replay-protection mapping and is included in the signed digest.
sourceChainId keys the replay-protection mapping and is included in the signed digest.
destChainId is emitted with the new cross chain request.
newTreasury is stored in pendingTreasury by proposeNewTreasury.
The tokens array drives the rescue loop and the external transfers.
newMaxCrossChainAmount is written into maxCrossChainAmount.
Each loop-local token reference is the target of the rescue transfer.
The measured token balance is the value transferred by rescue.
sigId is converted to the EIP-191 signed hash stored in local_sigIdHash.
local_sigIdHash is the digest verified by supervisor.checkSignatures.
